भव्य: भव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being, existing, being present; to be become, (sometimes used impersonally, e. g. भव्यम् अनेन, it is to be become by him); to be about to be or become; to be about to come to pass, future (= भाविन्); likely to be or occur, on the point of becoming [cf. धेनुम्-भव्या]; what ought to be, suitable, proper, fit, right (= योग्य); good, excellent; showy in appearance, handsome, beautiful, nice, pleasant; happy, auspicious, pros-perous, fortunate; calm, placid, tranquil in mind; true; (अस्), m., N. of a small fruit tree commonly called Kāmaraṅga, Averrhoa Carambola; of a son of Dhruva or the pole-star; of a son of Priya-vrata; of a Buddhist teacher; (आस्), m. pl. a particular class of gods under Manu Cākṣuṣa; (आ), f. an epithet of Umā (Pārvatī); = करि-पिप्पली; a sort of pepper, Piper Chaba, (a wrong form for चव्या); (अम्), n. that which is or exists (= यद् भवति); being, existence, the being present; future time (e. g. भ-वद्-भूत-भव्ये, in the present, past, and future); result, fruit; the fruit of the Averrhoa Carambola; the fruit of the Dillenia Indica; a bone; (अस्, अम्), m. n. a division of the poetical Rasas or sentiments. —भव्य-जीवन, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Niryukti-bhāṣya, a Gujarāṭhī commentary on certain Jaina doctrines. —भव्य-ता, f. suitableness, good-ness, excellence, beauty; futurity. —भव्य-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘of a good figure or form,’ good.
भशिरा: भशिरा भशिरा, f. a sort of beet, Beta Bengalensis.
भष्: भष् भष्, cl. 1. P. (in epic poetry also A.) भषति (-ते), बभाष, भषि-तुम्, to bark, growl; to bark at, rail against, re-proach, revile (with acc.).
भष: भष, अस्, ई, अम्, barking, yelping; chiding, Ved.; (अस्), m. a dog; (ई), f. a bitch; (आ), f., N. of a particular species of plant (= स्वर्ण-क्षीरी).
भषक: भषक, अस्, m. a barker, a dog.
भषण: भषण, अस्, m. a barker, a dog; (अम्), n. the act of barking, the barking of a dog.
भषत्: 1. भषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, barking, howling.
भषत् 2. भषत् (?), m. the heart; the thigh; wood.
भस्: भस् 1. भस्, cl. 3. P. बभस्ति (pl. बप्-सति, Impv. 3rd du. बब्धाम्, Pāṇ. VI. 4, 100), भसितुम्, Ved. to chew, chew asunder; to eat, eat up, devour, consume [cf. rt. 1. प्सा]; to crush; (according to the Dhātu-pāṭha) to blame or abuse [cf. rt. भर्त्स्]; to shine [cf. rts. 1. भा, भास्].
भसद्: भसद्, द्, m. the hinder parts [cf. भासद]; pudendum muliebre; mons Veneris; the sun; a month; time [cf. भसन्त, भासन्त]; a sort of duck; a float, raft.
भसद्य: भसद्य, अस्, आ, अम्, being or situated on the hinder parts.
भसन: भसन, अस्, m. a bee; (also भसल ?।)
भसन्त: भसन्त, अस्, m. time; [cf. भसद् and भ-वन्त।]
भसित: भसित, अस्, आ, अम्, reduced to ashes; (अम्), n. ashes.
भस्त्रका: भस्त्रका, f. a diminutive fr. भस्त्रा below; [cf. भस्त्राका, भस्त्रिका।]
भस्त्रा: भस्त्रा, f. a bellows or a large hide with valves and a clay nozzle so used; a leathern bottle or vessel (used for carrying or holding water); a skin, pouch, leathern bag [cf. मात्रा-भ्°]; a particular manner of recitation; [cf. भास्त्रायण।] —भस्त्रा-फल, f. a species of plant; (also written भस्त्र-फला।) —भस्त्रा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, furnished with a bellows or sack.
भस्त्राका: भस्त्राका, f. a diminutive fr. भस्त्रा above; [cf. भस्त्रका।]
भस्त्रिक: भस्त्रिक, अस्, ई, अम्, (according to Pāṇ. IV. 4, 16) = भस्त्रया हरति; (आ), f. (diminutive fr. भस्त्रा), a little bag.
भस्त्रीय: भस्त्रीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a bellows or leathern bag.
भस्मक: भस्मक, अस्, आ, अम्, in भस्मकाग्नि = भस्-माग्नि, q. v.; (अम्), n. a disease of the eyes (thick-ening of the membrane with indistinctness of vision); morbid appetite from over-digestion of food [cf. भस्माग्नि]; gold or silver; a species of plant (= विडङ्ग).
भस्मन्: भस्मन्, आ, आ, अ, chewing, consuming, Ved.; (अ), n. ‘what is crushed or consumed by fire,’ what is reduced to ashes, ashes; [cf. भास्मन।] —भस्म-कार, अस्, m. ‘making ashes,’ i. e. using the ashes of wood in place of soap or lye, a washerman. —भस्म-कूट, अस्, m. a heap of ashes; N. of a mountain in Kāma-rūpa; [cf. भस्माचल।] —भस्-म-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, see भस्मी-कृत. —भस्म-कौमुदी, f., N. of a work by Prāṇa-kṛṣṇa on quicksilver and other metals. —भस्म-गन्धा or भस्म-गन्धिका or भस्म-गन्धिनी, f. ‘having the smell of ashes,’ a kind of perfume (= रेणुका)। —भस्म-गर्भ, अम्, n. the tree Dalbergia Ougeinensis, = तिनिश; (आ), f. a species of plant (= कपिला); a kind of perfume (= रेणुका). —भस्म-गुण्ठन, अम्, n. the act of covering with ashes. —भस्म-चय, अस्, m. a heap of ashes, an ash-heap. —भस्म-च्छन्न, अस्, आ, अम्, covered with ashes. —भस्म-जाबाल, N. of an Upaniṣad. —भस्म-ता, f. the state or condition of ashes; (भस्मतां या, to go to ashes, become ashes.) —भस्म-तूल, अम्, n. frost, snow; a shower of dust (= पांसु-वर्ष); a number of villages. —भस्मनि-हुत, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘one who has sacrificed in ashes,’ i. e. done a useless work. —भस्म-पुञ्ज, अस्, m. a heap of ashes, quantity or collection of ashes. —भस्-म-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘friend of ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भस्म-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, become ashes, changed into ashes, dead. —भस्म-मेह, अस्, m. a particular disease of the bladder, a sort of gravel. —भस्म-राजी, f., Ved. a row of ashes, line or stripe of ashes. —भस्म-राशी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to turn into a heap of ashes. —भस्मराशी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, turned or changed into a heap of ashes. —भस्म-रेणु, उस्, m. the dust of ashes. —भस्म-रोग, अस्, m. a particular disease, a kind of bulimy; [cf. भस्-माग्नि।] —भस्म-रोगिन्, ई, इणी, इ, afflicted with the disease called bulimy. —भस्म-रोहा, f. ‘grow-ing on ashes,’ a species of plant (= दग्धा, दग्-ध-रुहा). —भस्म-लेपन, अम्, n. the act of smearing with ashes. —भस्म-विधि, इस्, m. any rite or ceremony performed with ashes. —भस्म-वेधक, अस्, m. camphor. —भस्म-शय्या-श-यान, अस्, m. ‘lying on a couch of ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भस्म-शायिन्, ई, m. ‘lying on ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भस्म-शुद्धि-कर, अस्, m. ‘performing purification with ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भस्म-सात्, ind. to the state of ashes, com-pletely into ashes; (with rt. कृ or नी, to reduce to ashes; with rt. गम् or या or अस् or भू, to go to the state of ashes, become ashes, be reduced to ashes.) —भस्म-स्नान, अम्, n. purification by ashes. —भस्मा-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to reduce to ashes. —भस्माख्य (°म-आख्°), अस्, आ, अम्, called ashes, nothing but ashes. —भस्माग्नि (°म-अग्°), इस्, m., N. of a disease in which the food is over-digested or as it were reduced to ashes, a kind of bulimy (?). —भस्मा-चल (°म-अच्°), अस्, m., N. of a mountain in Kāma-rūpa; [cf. भस्म-कूट।] —भस्मान्त (°म-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. ending in ashes, finish-ing with ashes (said of the body when burnt on the funeral pyre); भस्मान्ते, Ved. in the neighbour-hood of ashes. —भस्मान्ति, ind. (= भस्म-स-मीपे), near ashes, in the neighbourhood of ashes. —भस्मापस् (°म-आप्°), f. pl. water with ashes. —भस्मावृताङ्ग (°म-आव्°, °त-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having the body covered with ashes. —भस्-माह्वय (°म-आह्°), अस्, m. camphor. —भस्मी-करण, अम्, n. the act of reducing to ashes; com-pletely consuming or burning; calcining. —भस्मी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to make into ashes, reduce to ashes. —भस्मी-कृत, अस्, आ, अम्, reduced to ashes; calcined (as a metal). —भस्-मी-कृत्य, ind. having reduced to ashes. —भस्मी-भाव, अस्, m. the state or condition of becoming ashes. —भस्मी-भू, cl. 1. P. -भवति, -भवितुम्, to become ashes. —भस्मी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, be-come ashes, reduced to ashes, being mere ashes, being wholly worthless. —भस्मोद्धूलित-विग्रह (°म-उद्°), अस्, m. ‘whose body is strewed over with ashes,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भस्मोद्वपन (°म-उद्°), अम्, n., Ved. the act of pouring or shaking out ashes.
भा: भा 1. भा [cf. rts. 1. भस्, भाष्, भास्], cl. 2. P. भाति, बभौ, भास्यति, अभासीत्, भायात्, भातुम्, to shine, be bright or luminous, to be splendid or beautiful; to be conspicuous or eminent; to appear, seem; to show one's self, mani-fest any feeling; to be, exist: Pass. भायते: Caus. भापयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबीभपत्, to cause to shine or appear: Desid. बिभासति: Intens. बाभा-यते, बाभेति, बाभाति; [cf. Zend bā-nu, ‘a ray;’ bā-ma, ‘brightness:’ Gr. φη-μί, φά-σκ-ω, φά-τι-ς, φήμη, φανή, φαίνω, φαν-ε-ρό-ς, φαν-ή, φά-σι-ς, φά-σ-μα; φά-ε (Homeric), ‘he appeared;’ ὑπό-φαυ-σι-ς, φά-ος, φαῦ-ος, φῶς, φέγγ-ος, φα-έ-θ-ω, φαε-ίν-ω φαει-νό-ς, φᾱνό-ς, φαίδιμος, πι-φαύ-σκ-ω: Lat. fā-rī, fā-ma, fā-tu-m, fā-s, fā-bu-la, fă-t-eo-r, fa-c-s, fă-c-ie-s, făc-ē-tu-s, fav-illa, focus, februus (fr. the Caus.): Slav. o-ba-v-a-ti, ‘incan-tare;’ ba-s-nĭ, ‘a tale.’]

2. भा, भास्, f. [cf. 4. भ], light, brightness, splen-dor (Ved., cf. 2. भास्); lustre, beauty; the reflection of any object, shadow; (आस्), m. the sun. —भा-ऋजीक, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. light-shedding, radiating, radiant (Sāy. = प्रकाशस्य प्रार्जयितृ, said of Agni). —भा-कूट, अस्, m. ‘having a point or peak of light,’ a species of fish, (also भा-कुट); N. of a mountain (apparently the part of the Himālaya called Bhākūr). —भा-कोश, अस्, m. ‘repository of light,’ the sun. —भा-गण, अस्, m. the whole col-lection of stars or constellations, (for भ-गण।) —भा-त्वक्षस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, Ved. producing light. —भा-निकर, अस्, m. a multitude of rays, a mass of light. —भा-नेमि, इस्, m. ‘a circle of light or rays,’ the sun. —भान्-द, अम्, n. ‘giving light,’ N. of an Upa-Purāṇa. —भा-मण्डल, अम्, n. a circle of light, crown or diadem of light, garland of rays. —भामती, f. (fr. भा-मत्), or भामती-नि-बन्ध, अस्, m., N. of a commentary by Vācaspati-miśra on Śaṅkarācārya's commentary on the Brahma-sūtras. —भामती-कार, अस्, m., N. of Vācaspati-miśra, the author of the Bhāmatī as well as of several other treatises on the different systems of philosophy. —भामती-निबन्ध = भामती, q. v. —भा-रुचि, इस्, m., N. of an author mentioned in the Mitākṣarā to whom a commentary on Yājña-valkya's Dharma-śāstra is ascribed. —भा-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, (perhaps fr. भास् + रूप), Ved. light, shining, bright, splendid. —१। भा-वन, अम्, n. (for 2. भा-वन see p. 708, col. 1), a forest of light, sea of glory, a mass of rays. —भा-सर्व-ज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of an author.
भात्: भात्, भान्, भान्ती or भाती, भात्, shining, splendid.
भात: भात, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, bright, splendid, re-splendent; (अस्), m. dawn, morning.
भाति: भाति, इस्, f. light, brightness, splendor; the being clear or evident, perception, knowledge (= प्र-तीति).
भाति भाति, भातु। See p. 704, col. 1.
भातु: भातु, उस्, m. the sun; [cf. भानु।]
भान: भान, अम्, n. the act of appearing or growing visible, appearance; being clear or evident, per-ception. —भान-तस्, ind. in consequence of the appearance. —भान-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having the appearance.
भान भान, भानु, &c. See p. 704, col. 1.
भानवीय: भानवीय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भानु), Ved. coming from the sun (as rays); (अम्), n. the right eye.
भानु: भानु, उस्, m. appearance, brightness, light [cf. अहि-भ्°]; a ray of light; the sun; beauty; N. of an Āditya; day; a sovereign, king, prince, master; N. of Śiva (= हर); of a Deva-gandharva; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; of a Yādava; of the father of the fifteenth Arhat of the present Ava-sarpiṇī; of a prince (son of Prati-vyoma); of a son of Viśva-dhara and brother of Hari-nātha; of a pupil of Śaṅkarācārya; of an author; (अवस्), m. pl. the Ādityas (children of Bhānu); the gods of the third Manv-antara; (उस्), f. = भानु-मती, a hand-some woman; N. of a daughter of Dakṣa (wife of Dharma or Manu and mother of Bhānu or Āditya); of the mother of Devarṣabha; of a daughter of Kṛṣṇa; of the mother of the Dānava Śakuni. —भानु-केसर or भानु-केशर, अस्, m. the sun. —भानु-ज, अस्, m. ‘son of the Sun,’ the planet Saturn. —भानुजी-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of a son of Bhaṭṭoji-dīkṣita. —भानु-दत्त, अस्, m., N. of a man; of the author of the Rasa-taraṅgiṇī; of the author of the Rasa-mañjarī. —भानु-दिन, अम्, n. Sunday; [cf. भानु-वार।] —भानु-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of a commentator on the Amara-kośa. —भानु-देव, अस्, m., N. of a king. —भानु-पण्डित, अस्, m., N. of a poet with the epithet Śrī-vaidya. —भानु-फला, f. the plant Musa Sapien-tum; [cf. अंशुमत्-फला।] —भानु-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of the preceptor of Nārāyaṇa-dāsa. —भानु-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, luminous, splendid, resplendent; beautiful, handsome; containing the word भानु; (आन्), m. the sun; N. of a man with the patronymic Aupamanyava; of a warrior on the side of the Kurus, (according to the commentator) a son of Kaliṅga; of a son of Kuśa-dhuaja (or Keśi-dhvaja); of Bṛhad-aśva [cf. भानु-रथ]; of Bharga; of a son of Kṛṣṇa; (मती), f., N. of a daughter of Aṅgiras; of a daughter of Kṛta-vīrya (wife of Ahaṃ-yāti); of a daughter of the Yādava Bhānu; of a daughter of Vikramāditya; of the mother of Śaṅkara (who wrote a commentary on the Śakuntalā). —भा-नुमतिन्, ई, m. (fr. भानु-मत् or भानु + मति), Ved., N. of a man. —भानु-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, consisting of rays. —भानु-मित्र, अस्, m., N. of a king, a son of Candra-giri [cf. भानु-रथ]; of a son of Udaya-siṃha. —भानु-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king, a son of Candra-giri, (also written भानू-रथ); N. of a son of Bṛhad-aśva; [cf. भानु-मत्।] —भानु-वन, अम्, n. ‘wood of the sun,’ N. of a wood; (also read भार्ग-वन।) —भानु-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a man. —भानु-वार, अस्, m. ‘day of the sun,’ Sunday; [cf. भानु-दिन।]
भानुसेन: —भानु-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a man.
भानुल: भानुल, अस्, m. a diminutive from Bhānu-datta (used by way of endearment).
भाम: 1. भाम, अस्, m. (for 2. see rt. भाम्, p. 706), light, brightness, splendor; the sun. —भाम-नी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, Ved. ‘bearing light,’ an epithet of Puruṣa.
2. भाम, अस्, m. (for 1. see p. 704, col. 2; for 3. see below), passion, wrath, fury, anger; (आ), f. a passionate woman; = सत्य-भामा, one of the wives of Kṛṣṇa.
भाम 3. भाम or भामक, अस्, m. a sister's husband.
भामिन्: 1. भामिन्, ई, इनी, इ (fr. 1. भाम; for 2. see under rt. भाम्), shining, glittering, beautiful, hand-some; proud; (इनी), f. a handsome woman; N. of the daughter of a Gandharva. —भामिनी-विलास, अस्, m., N. of a poem by Jagan-nātha in four chapters, (the first book contains allegorical precepts, the second includes amatory subjects, the third an elegy [karuṇa] on the death of a wife, the fourth teaches that consolation is only to be obtained by adoration of Kṛṣṇa.)
2. भामिन्, ई, इनी, इ (for 1. see p. 704, col. 2), passionate, angry; (इनी), f. an angry or passionate woman, vixen, (often used as a term of endearment, in the same sense as मानिनी।)
भांश: भांश भांश। See under 4. भ, p. 694.
भाःकर: भाःकर भाः-कर, भाः-करण। See भास्-कर, &c., p. 709, col. 2.
भाःखर: भाःखर भाः-खर, भाः-पति, भाः-फेरु, = भास्-खर, &c., see Vopa-deva II. 45.
भाकुट: भाकुट भा-कुट, भा-कूट, भा-कोश। See under 2. भा, col. 1.
भाकुरि: भाकुरि भाकुरि, a patronymic. See भे-कुरि, p. 721, col. 1.
भाक्त: भाक्त 1. भाक्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भक्त), regularly fed by another; a dependent, retainer; fit for food.
2. भाक्त, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भक्ति), inferior, secon-dary, (opposed to मुख्य); (आस्), m. pl. ‘the faithful ones, the pious ones,’ N. of a Vaiṣṇava sect; of a Śaiva sect.
भाक्तिक: भाक्तिक, अस्, ई, अम्, = 1. भाक्त, regularly fed by another; (अस्), m. one who is fed by another, a dependent, retainer.
भाक्षालक: भाक्षालक भाक्षालक, relating to or com-ing from the place Bhakṣālī.
भाग: भाग 1. भाग, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भज्), a part, portion, share, lot, division, allotment, partition, distribution [cf. दाय-भ्°]; portioning out; good portion, fortunate lot, good fortune, luck, destiny (Ved.); a fraction, part of any whole, a part of a whole (e. g. शत-भ्°, the hundredth part); a quarter (in एक-भ्°, one fourth; त्रि-भ्°, three fourth); part of anything given as interest; the numerator of a fraction; a division of time, the thirtieth part of a Rāśi or zodiacal sign; a degree or 360th part of the circumference of a great circle; a quotient; a half rupee; place, spot, region, side, border; N. of a king, (also भागवत); N. of one of the branches of the river Candra-bhāgā, q. v.; (अस्, आ, अम्), taking the place of any one, representing, (at the end of adj. comps., cf. भाजन); (अम्), n., N. of a parti-cular Sāman. —भाग-कल्पना, f. the allotment of shares. —भाग-जाति, इस्, f. assimilation of fractions, reduction of fractions to a common denominator; [cf. अंश-सवर्णन।] —भागजाति-चतुष्टय, अम्, n. four modes of assimilation of fractions or of reducing them to a common denominator. —भा-गञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of a man. —भाग-दा, आस्, आस्, अम्, Ved. granting or giving a share. —भाग-दुघ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. yielding or dealing out portions, distributing. —भाग-ध, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. paying a share, discharging or paying what is due. —भाग-धेय, अम्, n. share, portion, part, lot, portion allotted by destiny, luck, fortune, fate, destiny; property; happiness; (अस्), m. revenue, tax, dues, impost; one to whom a share is due, an heir, co-heir; (अस्, ई, अम्), Ved. due as a share or part. —भाग-भाज्, क्, क्, क्, having a share in (any-thing), interested, a partner. —भाग-भुज्, क्, m. ‘enjoying taxes,’ a king, sovereign. —भाग-मातृ, ता, f. a particular rule of division. —भाग-मुख, अस्, m., N. of a man. —भाग-लक्षणा, f. (in rhetoric) insinuation or intimation of a part. —भा-ग-विज्ञेय, अस्, m., N. of a man. —भाग-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a work. —भागवृत्ति-कार, अस्, m., N. of an author mentioned in the Prauḍha-mano-ramā. —भाग-शस्, ind. in parts or portions, according to a share or portion; one part after another, by turns, alternately; by and by. —भाग-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, taking a part, sharing; (अस्), m. a co-heir; (in arithmetic) division. —भाग-हार, अस्, m. (in arithmetic) division; [cf. भाजन, छेदन।] —भाग-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, inheriting; (ई), m. an heir. —भागानुबन्ध-जाति (°ग-अन्°), इस्, f. assi-milation of quantities by fractional increase; reduc-tion of quantities to uniformity by the addition of a fraction. —भागापहार-जाति (°ग-अप्°), इस्, f. assi-milation of quantities by fractional decrease, reduction of quantities to uniformity by the subtraction of a fraction. —भागार्थिन् (°ग-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, desirous of a share (as of a sacrifice). —भागार्ह (°ग-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, entitled to a portion or inheritance; to be divided according to shares. —भागासुर (°ग-अस्°), अस्, m., N. of an Asura. —भागी-कृ, cl. 8. P. A. -करोति, -कुरुते, -कर्तुम्, to divide, share.
2. भाग, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. relating to Bhaga (as a hymn).
भागक: भागक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of an adj. comp.) = 1. भाग, q. v., sharing, dividing; (अस्), m. (?), a divisor (in arithmetic).
भागन: भागन, अम्, n. (? for भा-गण, col. 1), the period of the sun's passing through the signs of the zodiac; the zodiac; the circumference of a great circle.
भागवत: भागवत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भग-वत्), relating to or coming from Bhaga-vat, i. e. Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; worshipping Bhaga-vat; holy, sacred, divine; (अस्), m. a follower of Bhaga-vat, worshipper of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa; N. of a king. —भागवत-तात्पर्य, अम्, n., N. of a work by Ānanda-tīrtha or Madhu. —भागवत-पुराण, अम्, n., N. of the most celebrated and popular of the eighteen Purāṇas, especially dedicated to the glorification of Viṣṇu, (it was narrated by Śuka, son of Vyāsa, to king Parīkṣit, grandson of Arjuna, who in consequence of a hermit's curse had been bitten by as snake, and desired to die with his thoughts fixed on Viṣṇu; the tenth book, which is the most characteristic and best known part of the Purāṇa, is devoted to the history of Kṛṣṇa.) —भागवत-भावार्थ-दी-पिका (°व-अर्°), f., N. of a commentary by Śrī-dhara on the Bhāgavata-Purāṇa. —भागवत-लीला-रहस्य, अम्, n., N. of a work. —भागवत-सन्-दर्भ, अस्, m., N. of a work. —भागवत-सार-समुच्चय, अस्, m. (perhaps) N. of a collection of the works of Vallabha. —भागवतामृत (°त-अम्°), अम्, n., N. of a work.
भागवति: भागवति, इस्, m. (probably) a patronymic from Bhaga-vat.
भागवित्त: भागवित्त, आस्, m. pl. the pupils or followers of Bhāgavittika.
भागवित्तायन: भागवित्तायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhā-gavitti.
भागवित्ति: भागवित्ति, इस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Bha-gavitta; N. of a son of Kuthumi.
भागवित्तिक: भागवित्तिक, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhā-gavitti.
भागवित्तिकीय: भागवित्तिकीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhāgavittika.
भागिक: भागिक, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to a part; forming one part; having a part; fractional; bearing interest, subject to a fractional deduction for interest, (भागि-कं शतम्, one part in a hundred, i. e. one per cent; भागिका विंशतिः, one part in twenty, i. e. five per cent); (अस्), m., N. of a man.
भागिन्: भागिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having a portion or share, shar-ing, one who shares, a partner; sharing in, partaking of, participating in [cf. दुःख-भ्°]; concerned in, (अपचय-भागिन्, concerned in a loss); one to whom a share is due, entitled to; possessing, a pos-sessor, owner; consisting of parts or shares; having a good portion, having luck, lucky, fortunate; (ई), m. a co-heir; (इनी), f. a co-heiress.
भागिनेय: भागिनेय, अस्, m. (fr. भगिनी), a sister's son; (ई), f. a sister's daughter.
भागीयस्: भागीयस्, आन्, असी, अस् (compar. of भागिन्), hav-ing a larger share, entitled to a larger share.
भागीरथ: भागीरथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भगीरथ), relating to Bhagīratha; (ई), f. a N. of the Ganges; also of one of the three main streams or branches of the Ganges, viz. the great western branch; [cf. नव-द्वीप।] —भागीरथ-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a place of pilgrimage.
भाग्य: 1. भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. भग), relating to Bhaga; (with युग) the twelfth or last lustrum in Jupiter's cycle of sixty years; (अम्), n., scil. भ or नक्षत्र, the asterism of Bhaga or = the seven-teenth asterism or latter Phalgunī (see नक्षत्र).

2. भाग्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. भाग or fr. rt. भज्), to be shared, to be divided, divisible (= भज्य); entitled to a share; = भागिक, forming a part, sub-ject to a fractional deduction (e. g. भाग्यं शतम्, one for a hundred, one in a hundred, one per cent); lucky, fortunate [cf. निर्-भ्°]; (अम् or आनि), n. sing. or plur. good or bad fortune (resulting from merit or demerit in former existences); lot, luck, fate, destiny, fortune; happiness, welfare; sensual pleasure (?); (एन), ind. by good fortune, fortunately, happily. —भाग्य-क्रमेण, ind. in course of fortune. —भाग्य-भाव, अस्, m. state of fortune. —भा-ग्य-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having good qualities, possess-ing good fortune, fortunate; happy, prosperous. —भाग्यवत्-ता, f. fortunateness, good fortune. —भाग्य-वशात्, ind. from the force or influence of destiny, through the will of fate, through fortune. —भाग्य-वृत्ति, इस्, f. course or state of fortune, destiny. —भाग्योदय (°य-उद्°), अस्, m. rise or dawn of fortune, commencement of good fortune, rising prosperity.
भाज्: भाज्, क्, क्, क्, (usually at the end of comps.) sharing, a sharer; sharing in, participating in, par-taking of; entitled to; possessing, a possessor, ob-taining, having, enjoying [cf. रिक्थ-भ्°, मोक्ष-भ्°, स्वप्न-भ्°]; perceiving, feeling, being sensible of, devoting one's self to; forming a part of, be-longing to (Ved.); joined or connected with; occu-pying (as a seat, place), inhabiting, living in, dwelling in or on [cf. विष्टर-भ्°, हर्म्य-भ्°, यमुना-भ्°]; seeking, resorting to, going to, (अङ्क-भाज्, going to the side or to close proximity, close at hand, soon to be accomplished); flowing to; revering, worshipping (e. g. अनन्य-भाज्, worshipping no other); honouring [cf. लब्ध-वर्ण-भ्°]; falling to the share or lot of; what is due, duty, concern, business, (Bhaṭṭi-k. III. 21 = कर्तव्य।)
भाजक: भाजक, अस्, m. (fr. Caus. of rt. भज्), dividing; (in arithmetic) a divisor.
भाजन: भाजन, अम्, n. (fr. the Caus.), the act of sharing, dividing; (in arithmetic) division; a vessel, cup, pot, dish, plate, (often found at the end of a comp., e. g. जल-भ्°, पान-भ्°); a particular measure = an Āḍhaka = 64 Palas; a vessel (metaphorically), a re-ceptacle for anything, repository, recipient, a place or person in which anything is collected or in whom any quality is conspicuous [cf. प्रीति-विश्रम्भ-भ्°]; a fit person in general, a deserving person, clever or capable person [cf. पात्र]; the act of representing or taking the place of, representation; (at the end of comps.) a representative, deputy, anything which serves for or is equivalent to (Ved.); भाजनेन, in place of, in lieu of, instead of; (अस्), m., N. of a man; the patronymic formed from this N., see Gaṇa Gopa-vanādi to Pāṇ. II. 4, 67; (अस्, आ, अम्), sharing, par-ticipating in, entitled to (at the end of comps.); relat-ing to, belonging to (at the end of comps., Ved.). —भाजन-ता, f. or भाजन-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being a vessel or receptacle for anything, the pos-sessing (of any quality &c.), the being a (fit) vessel, fitness, worthiness, the being worthy of or entitled to; a fit object. —भाजन-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. a word used in Nirukta IV. 10, XI. 19, XII. 17, to explain the word भद्र. —भाजनी-भूत, अस्, आ, अम्, having become a vessel or receptacle for anything, i. e. having become a participator in or possessor of.
भाजयु: भाजयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. communicating, sharing with others, generous, liberal.
भाजित: भाजित, अस्, आ, अम्, shared, divided, distributed, apportioned, allotted, portioned; (अम्), n. a share, portion.
भाजिन्: भाजिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of comps.) sharing, participating in; connected with.
भाज्य: भाज्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be divided, divisible, to be portioned or distributed; (अम्), n. a portion, share; an inheritance; (in arithmetic) the dividend.
भागल: भागल भागल, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhagala.
भागलक: भागलक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhagala.
भागलि: भागलि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bhagala; N. of a preceptor.
भागलेय: भागलेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhāgali.
भाङ्कार: भाङ्कार भाङ्-कार, perhaps = झङ्-कार, q. v.; [cf. भेरी-भ्°।]
भाङ्ग: भाङ्ग भाङ्ग, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भङ्गा, hemp), hempen, of hemp, made or consisting of hemp.
भाङ्गक: भाङ्गक (fr. भङ्ग, a fracture), a tattered or ragged cloth.
भाङ्गासुरि: भाङ्गासुरि, इस्, m. (fr. भङ्गासुर), a patro-nymic of Ṛtu-parṇa. —भाङ्गासुरि-नृपाज्ञा (°प-आज्°), f. the command of king Bhāṅgāsuri.
भाङ्गीन: भाङ्गीन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भङ्गा), bearing or growing hemp; (अम्), n., scil. क्षेत्र, a field of hemp.
भाङ्गिल: भाङ्गिल भाङ्गिल, N. of a place.
भाङ्गिलेय: भाङ्गिलेय, अस्, m., N. of a man; (अस्, ई, अम्), coming from Bhāṅgila (?).
भाजक्: भाजक् भाजक्, ind. quickly, swiftly; (pro-bably incorrectly for ताजक्।)
भाट: भाट भाट (fr. rt. भट्), wages, hire, rent.
भाटक: भाटक, अस्, m. price paid for anything, wages, hire, rent.
भाटि: भाटि, इस्, f. wages, hire, fee; earnings of prosti-tutes.
भाट्ट: भाट्ट भाट्ट, अस्, m. a follower of Bhaṭṭa (i. e. Kumārila-bhaṭṭa); (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people. —भाट्ट-चिन्ता-मणि, इस्, m., N. of a commentary by Viśveśvara-bhaṭṭa (better known as Gāgā-bhaṭṭa) on the Mīmāṃsā-sūtra. —भाट्ट-तन्त्र, अम्, n., N. of a work. —भाट्ट-दिनकर, N. of a com-mentary by Bhaṭṭa Dinakara on the Mīmāṃsā work Śāstra-dīpikā. —भाट्ट-दीपिका, f., N. of a commen-tary by Khaṇḍa-deva on Jaimini's Mīmāṃsā-sūtra. —भाट्टदीपिका-प्रभावली, f., N. of a commen-tary on the preceding work by Śambhu-bhaṭṭa. —भाट्ट-भाषा-प्रकाशिका, f. ‘explanation of the language of the Bhāṭṭas,’ an index to the terminology of the Bhāṭṭas by Nārāyaṇa-tīrtha or Nārāyaṇa-muni. —भाट्ट-भास्कर, N. of a work by Jīva-deva, being a concise account of the various Mīmāṃsā schools and their doctrines; [cf. भाट्ट-दिनकर।] —भाट्ट-रहस्य, अम्, n. ‘the secret or mystic doctrine of the Bhāṭṭas,’ N. of an elementary Mī-māṃsā disquisition by Khaṇḍa-deva.
भाडितायन: भाडितायन भाडितायन, अस्, m. a patro-nymic from Bhaḍita.
भाडिलायन: भाडिलायन भाडिलायन, अस्, m. a patro-nymic from Bhaḍila, q. v.
भाण्: भाण् भाण्, Ved. (onomatopoetic) imitation of the noise of breathing or hissing.
भाण: भाण भाण, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भण्, q. v.), N. of a sort of dramatic entertainment (in which one only of the interlocutors appears on the scene, or described as a narrative of some intrigue told either by the hero or a third person). —भाण-स्थान, अम्, n., N. of a place.
भाणक: भाणक, अस्, m. a proclaimer, announcer, de-clarer.
भाणिका: भाणिका, f. a kind of dramatic performance; [cf. भाण above.]
भाण्ड: भाण्ड भाण्ड, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भण् or भण्ड्?), the plant Thespesia Populneoides; (ई), f. (perhaps) = भण्डी, Rubia Munjista [cf. काक-भ्°, काल-भाण्-डिका]; (अम्), n. any vessel, pot, pan, cup, plate, dish, pail, vat, utensil [cf. पाक-भ्°, पान-भ्°]; any chest, box, trunk, case [cf. क्षुर-भ्°]; any implement, tool, instrument; any musical instrument (= वाद्य-भ्°); a pack or bale (of goods or mer-chandise); horse-trappings, harness; an ornament in general; the stock (of a shopkeeper), goods, wares, merchandise, the capital or principal (of a merchant); the bed of a river, the space between its banks; mimicry, buffoonery, the practice of the Bhaṇḍa or professional jester; (आस्), m. pl. wares, merchandise. —भाण्ड-गोपक, अस्, m. the keeper of vessels or utensils (in a Buddhist temple). —भाण्ड-पति, इस्, m. a possessor of wares, a merchant. —भाण्ड-पुट, अस्, m. ‘sharpener of instruments, i. e. razors,’ a barber. —भाण्ड-पुष्प, अस्, m. a sort of snake. —भाण्ड-प्रति-भाण्डक, अम्, n. ‘commodity for commodity,’ computation of the exchange of goods, barter (in arithmetic). —भाण्ड-भजक, अस्, m. the distributer of vessels or utensils (in a Buddhist temple). —भाण्ड-भरक, अस्, m. the contents of any vessel. —भाण्ड-मूल्य, अम्, n. capital consisting of wares. —भाण्ड-वादन, अम्, n. playing on a musical instrument. —भाण्ड-शाला, f. a store-house, store-room, magazine. —भाण्डा-गार (°ड-आग्°), अम्, n. a store-room, store-house, place where household goods and utensils are kept; a magazine, treasury; a treasure, store. —भाण्डागा-रिक, अस्, m. the overseer of a store-house, store-keeper, keeper of magazine; a steward, treasurer. —भाण्डानुसारिन् (°ड-अन्°), ई, इणी, इ, hanging to a pot or vessel. —भाण्डा-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a city. —भाण्डोदर (°ड-उद्°), अम्, n. the cavity or interior of a vessel. —भाण्डोपपुराण (°ड-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa.
भाण्डक: भाण्डक, अस्, अम्, m. n. a small vessel, cup, plate, utensil, box, chest; (इका), f. an implement, tool, utensil; = भाण्डी, see काल-भ्°; (अम्), n. goods, merchandise.
भाण्डायनि: भाण्डायनि, इस्, m. a patronymic (probably) from Bhāṇḍa.
भाण्डार: भाण्डार = भाण्डागार (of which it is a corrupt or contracted form). —भाण्डार-गृह, अम्, n. a store-house.
भाण्डारिक: भाण्डारिक, अस्, m. = भाण्डागारिक, q. v.
भाण्डारिन्: भाण्डारिन्, ई, m. the keeper of a store-house, steward, treasurer (= भाण्डागारिक).
भाण्डी: भाण्डी, a razor-case; [cf. भाण्डि-वाह, भाण्-डिल, and क्षुर-भाण्ड।] —भाण्डि-वाह, अस्, m. a barber. —भाण्डि-शाला, f. (probably) a barber's shop.
भाण्डिक: भाण्डिक, अस्, m. a barber; [cf. भाण्डिल, भाण्डि।]
भाण्डिजङ्घि: भाण्डिजङ्घि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bhaṇḍi-jaṅgha.
भाण्डित: भाण्डित, आस्, m. pl. of भाण्डित्य below, see Gaṇa Kaṇvādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 111.
भाण्डितायन: भाण्डितायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhaṇ-ḍita; [cf. भाडितायन।]
भाण्डित्य: भाण्डित्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhaṇḍita; [cf. भाण्डित।]
भाण्डिनी: भाण्डिनी, f. (fr. भाण्ड), a chest, a basket (= मञ्जूषा).
भाण्डिलायन: भाण्डिलायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhaṇ-ḍila.
भाण्डीर: भाण्डीर, अस्, m., N. of a lofty Nyag-rodha tree on the Govardhana in Vṛndā-vana; = वट, the Indian fig-tree [cf. भण्डीर]; N. of a Dānava. —भाण्डीर-वन, अम्, n., N. of a forest. —भाण्-डीरवन-वासिन्, ई, m. ‘dwelling in the Bhāṇḍīra forest,’ N. of Kṛṣṇa.
भादिग: भादिग भादिग, अस्, m., N. of a man.
भाद्र: भाद्र भाद्र, अस्, m. (fr. भद्र), the month Bhādra, = भाद्रपद below; (ई), f., scil. तिथि, the day of full moon in the month Bhādra.
भाद्रदारव: भाद्रदारव, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhadra-dāru, q. v.
भाद्रपद: भाद्रपद, अस्, m. (fr. भद्र-पदा), the month Bhādra (a rainy month corresponding to a period in our calendar from about the middle of August to the middle of September); (आ), f. (also ए, du., आस्, pl.), = भद्र-पदा, a name common to the third and fourth lunar asterisms or Nakṣatras [cf. नक्षत्र]; (ई), f. the day of full moon in the month Bhādrapada.
भाद्रमातुर: भाद्रमातुर, अस्, m. (fr. भद्र-मातृ), the son of a virtuous or handsome mother.
भाद्रमौञ्ज: भाद्रमौञ्ज, अस्, ई, अम्, Ved. made from Bhadra (a kind of Cyperus grass) and Muñja.
भाद्रवर्मण: भाद्रवर्मण, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhadra-varman.
भाद्रशर्मि: भाद्रशर्मि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bhadra-śarman.
भाद्रसाम: भाद्रसाम, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhadra-sāman.
भान्त: भान्त भान्त, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. perhaps a participle of rt. भाम् below; (according to Mahī-dhara) = वज्र-रूप, having the shape of a thunder-bolt, or = चन्द्र, the moon.
भान्द: भान्द भान्-द, अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa (see under 2. भा, p. 704, col. 1).
भाम्: भाम् भाम्, cl. 1. A. भामते, बभामे, &c., or (by Dhātu-pāṭha XXXV. 20) cl. 10. P. भामयति, &c., Ved. to be angry or wrath-ful; to be impatient: Intens. बाभाम्यते, to be very angry.
भामित: भामित, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. enraged, angry.
भामह: भामह भामह, अस्, m., N. of the author of the Mano-ramā commentary and of a treatise on the art of rhetoric.
भायजात्य: भायजात्य भायजात्य, अस्, m. (fr. भय-जात), a patronymic of Kapi-vana; of Nikothaka.
भार: भार भार, अस्, m. (fr. rt. भृ), a burden, load, weight, gravity [cf. अति-भ्°, अंस-भ्°]; heavy work, labour, toil, trouble; a large quantity, mass, bulk, (often connected with words meaning ‘hair,’ e. g. जटा-भार-धर, wearing a great quantity of matted hair); a particular weight = 20 Tulās = 2000 Palas of gold; a pole or yoke for carrying burdens [cf. उदक-भ्°]; an epithet of Viṣṇu. —भार-जीविन्, ई, m. one who earns his livelihood by carrying loads. —भार-भारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, Ved. bearing or carrying a load or weight. —भार-भूति-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha. —भार-भृत्, त्, त्, त्, Ved. = भार-भारिन्. —भार-यष्टि, इस्, f. a pole or yoke (generally laid over the shoulder) for carry-ing burdens. —भार-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a weight or load, loaded, burdened, bearing a burden. —भारवत्-त्व, अम्, n. the state of carrying a load, weightiness, ponderousness. —भार-वाह्, वाट्, भारौही, वाट्, bearing a burden, carrying a load. —भार-वाह, अस्, m. a bearer of burdens, porter, carrier; (ई), f. indigo. —भार-वाहन, अस्, m. a burden-bearer, beast of burden, pack-bearer; (अम्), n. a vehicle for loads, a cart, waggon. —भार-वाहिक, अस्, ई, अम्, load-bearing, carrying burdens; (अस्), m. a load-bearer, porter. —भार-वाहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, load-bearing, carrying a burden; (ई), m. a burden-bearer, porter. —भार-वृक्ष, अस्, m. a fragrant substance commonly called Kākṣī (con-sidered variously as a vegetable or a mineral product). —भार-सह, अस्, आ, अम्, burden-bearing, able to carry a great weight, very strong or powerful. —भा-र-साधन, अस्, ई, अम्, or भार-साहिन्, ई, इनी, इ, accomplishing difficult feats (said of certain weapons), effecting great objects. —भार-हर, अस्, आ, अम्, or भार-हार, अस्, आ, or ई, अम्, load-bearing, carrying a weight, bearing burdens; (अस्), m. a burden-bearer, porter. —भार-हारिक, अस्, ई, अम्, burden-bearing, carrying a load; relating or referring to the carrying of loads. —भार-हारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, load-bearing, carrying weights; (ई), m. an epithet of Kṛṣṇa. —भाराक्रान्त (°र-आक्°), अस्, आ, अम्, oppressed by a burden, overburdened, heavily laden, bearing a heavy burden; (आ), f. a species of the Atyaṣṭi metre, four times — — — —, ∪ ∪ ∪ ∪ ∪ —, ∪ — ∪ ∪ — ∪ —; [cf. मन्दाक्रान्ता।] —भारावतरण or भारा-वतारण (°र-अव्°), अम्, n. the taking down or removal of a burden, taking away a burden. —भा-रोढि (°र-ऊढि), इस्, f. the bearing of a burden. —भारोद्धरण (°र-उद्°), अम्, n. the act of raising up or lifting a burden. —भारोद्वह (°र-उद्°), अस्, m. a burden-carrier, porter. —भारोपजी-वन (°र-उप्°), अम्, n. living by burdens, earning a livelihood by carrying weights. —भारौही, f., see भार-वाह् above.
भारक: भारक, अम्, n. a load, burden, weight, a par-ticular weight; (अस्, इका, अम्), loaded with, (at the end of comps.; cf. फणि-भारिका।)
भाराय: भाराय, Nom. A. भारायते, &c., to become a burden, form a load; to be like a load.
भारिक: भारिक, अस्, आ, अम्, forming a load, heavy; swollen (said of a particular kind of elephantiasis); (अस्), m. a burden-bearer, porter.
भारिन्: भारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, bearing a load, carrying a burden, a bearer, porter [cf. भार-भ्°]; having weight, heavy, ponderous. —भारि-त्व, अम्, n. heaviness.
भारङ्गी: भारङ्गी भारङ्गी, f., see Gaṇa Kāśyādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 116.
भारङ्गिक: भारङ्गिक, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, an adj. from the preceding.
भारण्ड: भारण्ड भारण्ड, अस्, m., N. of a fabulous bird, (also written भारुण्ड, भेरण्ड, भेरुण्ड); (ई), f. the female of the above bird.
भारत: भारत भारत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भरत), de-scended from Bharata; belonging or relating to the Bharatas; (with सङ्ग्राम, समिति, युद्ध, स-मर) the war or battle of the Bharatas; (with कथा, आख्यान, इतिहास) the story of the Bharatas, the history or narrative of their war, (in this sense also भारतम्, n.); (with वर्ष) India (so called from its king Bharata, son of Dushyanta; in this sense also भारतम्, n.); an inhabitant of India or Bhārata-varṣa; भारतं सरस्, N. of a lake; (अस्), m. a descendant of Bharata; N. of Agni or Fire (so called, according to Sāy., either ‘as sprung from the priests called Bharatas,’ or ‘as bearer of the oblation’); an actor, a mime [cf. भरत]; N. of Deva-śravas; of Deva-rāta; an epithet of the sun shining on the south of Meru; (ई), f., N. of a Vedic goddess (invoked among the Ā-prī deities together with Ilā and Sarasvatī [cf. आ-प्री] or sometimes with Hotrā and Varūtrī; according to Yāska, Nirukta VIII. 13, she is a daughter of Āditya); the goddess of speech, Sarasvatī; speech, voice, word, eloquence, literary composition, the dramatic art, dramatic reci-tation or declamation; (with वृत्ति) a particular kind of style; a quail; N. of a river; (ई), m., N. of a teacher (‘personified speech’); अश्व-मेध भा-रत, N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 27. —भारत-तात्पर्य-निर्णय, अस्, m., N. of a work. —भारत-भाव-दीप, अस्, m. ‘light of the meaning of the Bhārata,’ N. of Nīla-kaṇṭha's com-mentary on the Mahā-bhārata. —भारत-सङ्ग्र-ह-दीपिका, f. = भारतार्थ-दीपिका, q. v. —भा-रत-सत्तम, अस्, m. the best of the descendants of Bharata. —भारताचार्य (°त-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a preceptor; of Arjuna-miśra (a commentator on the Mahā-bhārata). —भारतार्थ-दीपिका (°त-अर्°), f. ‘light of the meaning of the Bhārata,’ N. of a commentary by Arjuna-miśra on the Mahā-bhārata. —भारतार्थ-प्रकाश, अस्, m. ‘light of the meaning of the Bhārata,’ N. of Nārāyaṇa's commen-tary on the Mahā-bhārata. —भारती-कवि, इस्, m., N. of a poet mentioned in the Śārṅgadhara-paddhati. —भारती-कृष्णाचार्य (°ण-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —भारती-चन्द्र, अस्, m., N. of a king. —भारती-तीर्थ, अम्, n., N. of a sacred bathing-place; (अस्), m., N. of the author of the philosophical treatise Pañca-daśī, (he was preceptor of Mādhavācārya.) —भारती-यति, इस्, m., N. of the author of the Tattva-kaumudī-vyākhyā. —भा-रती-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. accompanied by Bhāratī; (आन्), m. an epithet of Indra. —भारती-श्री-नृ-सिंह, अस्, m., N. of a preceptor.
भारतेय: भारतेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhārata (or from Bharata).
भारद्वाज: भारद्वाज भारद्वाज, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भरद्-वाज), coming from or relating to Bharad-vāja; (अस्), m., N. of Śūṣa Vāhneya; of Śaunahotra; of Satya-vāha; of Sukeśan; of Śauṅga; of Droṇa (who was son of Bharad-vāja and preceptor of the Kurus and Pāṇḍus); of one of the seven Ṛṣis; of a son of Bṛhas-pati; of the Muni Agastya; of a grammarian; the planet Mars (according to the Graha-yajña-tattva); a skylark [cf. भरद्-वाज]; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people [cf. भरद्-वाज]; (ई), f. a particular species of bird; the wild cotton shrub; N. of a river; (अम्), n. a bone; N. of a country; (a various reading for भरद्-वाज।) —भारद्वाजी-पुत्र, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a preceptor.
भारद्वाजक: भारद्वाजक, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging or relating to Bharad-vāja.
भारद्वाजायन: भारद्वाजायन, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bharad-vāja.
भारद्वाजिन्: भारद्वाजिन्, इनस्, m. pl. (fr. भरद्-वाज or भारद्वाज), N. of a school; [cf. भरद्-वाजिन्।]
भारद्वाजीय: भारद्वाजीय, अस्, आ, अम्, coming from or relat-ing to Bhāradvāja; (आस्), m. pl., N. of the school of the grammarian Bhāradvāja.
भारमेय: भारमेय भारमेय, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bharama, q. v.
भारय: भारय भारय, अस्, m. = भारद्वाज, a sky-lark.
भारव: भारव भारव, अम्, n. a bow-string; (ई), f. sacred basil.
भारवि: भारवि भारवि, इस्, m., N. of the author of the poem called Kirātārjunīya.
भारि: भारि भारि, इस्, m. a lion.
भारुजिक: भारुजिक भारुजिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भरुज), relating to or coming from a jackal.
भारुण्ड: भारुण्ड भारुण्ड, अस्, m. = भारण्ड, q. v.; (अम्), n., N. of a Sāman; of a wood mentioned in Rāmāyaṇa II. 71, 5.
भार्ग: भार्ग भार्ग, अस्, m. a king of the Bhargas; N. of a son of Pratardana; of a king also called Bharga; (ई), f. a queen of the Bhargas; the plant Clerodendrum Siphonanthus. —भार्ग-भुमि, इस्, m., N. of a king; [cf. भर्ग-भूमि and भृगु-भूमि।] —भार्ग-वन, अम्, n., N. of a forest; (a various reading has भानु-वन।) —भार्ग-श्री-कान्त-मिश्र, अस्, m., N. of an author.
भार्गायण: भार्गायण, अस्, m. (fr. भर्ग), Ved. a patro-nymic of Sutvan.
भार्गि: भार्गि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bharga.
भार्गलेश्वरतीर्थ: भार्गलेश्वरतीर्थ भार्गलेश्वर-तीर्थ (°ल-ईश्°), अम्, n., N. of a Tīrtha.
भार्गव: भार्गव भार्गव, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhṛgu, belonging to Bhṛgu; (अस्), m. epithet of Cyavana [cf. चण्ड-भ्°]; of Gṛtsa-mada; of Dvi-gat; of Dṛśāna; of Iṭala; of Mārkaṇḍeya; of Śaunaka; of Ṛcīka; of Jamad-agni; of Paraśu-rāma; of Pramati; of Śiva; the planet Venus (pro-perly a patronymic of Śukra, regent of the planet Venus and preceptor of the Daityas); an archer, a good archer (= धन्विन्, सु-धन्वन्); an ele-phant; (आस्), m. pl. ‘the descendants of Bhṛgu,’ commonly called Bhṛgavas, N. of a particular tribe; (ई), f. a female descendant of Bhṛgu; N. of Deva-yāni; an epithet of Lakṣmī; an epithet of Pārvatī; = दूर्वा, bent grass, Panicum Dactylon; = नील-दूर्वा; = श्वेत-दूर्वा. —भार्गव-दीपिका, f., N. of a work. —भार्गव-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘dear to Śukra or to the planet Venus,’ a diamond. —भार्ग-वार्चन-दीपिका (°व-अर्°), f., N. of a work; [cf. भार्गव-दीपिका।] —भार्गवालाप (°व-आल्°), अस्, m., N. of the third Act of the Abhirāma-maṇi-nāṭaka. —भार्गवोपपुराण (°व-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of an Upa-Purāṇa. —भार्गवोपाख्यान (°व-उप्°), अम्, n., N. of the thirteenth chapter of the Vāsiṣṭha-rāmāyaṇa, commonly called Yoga-vāsiṣṭha.
भार्गवीय: भार्गवीय, अस्, आ, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhārgava.
भार्द्वाजी: भार्द्वाजी भार्द्वाजी, f. = भारद्वाजी, the wild cotton shrub.
भार्मन्: भार्मन् भार्मन् (fr. rt. भृ), Ved. bring-ing, waiting upon, serving.
भार्म्य: भार्म्य भार्म्य, अस्, m. a patronymic of Mudgala.
भार्म्यश्व: भार्म्यश्व, अस्, m. (fr. भृम्यश्व), a patro-nymic of Mugdala; [cf. भर्म्याश्व।]
भार्य: भार्य भार्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. भृ), to be borne, to be supported, to be cherished or nourished; to be maintained, dependent for a livelihood on another; (अस्), m. a servant, dependent, mercenary; (आ), f. a wife (espoused according to the ritual of the Vedas), any wife; the female of an animal. —भार्-याट (°या-आट), अस्, आ, अम्, living by the prostitution of a wife; [cf. पत्न्य्-आट।] —भार्याटिक, अस्, m. a husband under the rule of his wife, a hen-pecked husband; a species of antelope (= हरिणान्तर); N. of a Muni. —भार्या-त्व, अम्, n. wifehood, the state of being a wife, the condition of a wife. —भार्याधिकारिक (°या-अध्°), अस्, आ, अम्, relat-ing to the chapter on wives. —भार्या-पति-त्व, अम्, n. the being man and wife, conjugal union. —भार्या-पती, m. du. husband and wife. —भार्-यार्थिन् (°या-अर्°), ई, m. seeking or desiring a wife. —भार्या-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having a wife. —भार्-या-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the tree Cæsalpina Sappan (= पत्तङ्ग). —भार्योढ (°या-ऊढ), अस्, m. = ऊढ-भार्य, married (said of a man).
भार्यक: भार्यक = भार्या, a wife, (at the end of a comp., e. g. स-भ्°, q. v.)
भार्यारु: भार्यारु, उस्, m. (fr. भार्या), the father of a child by another man's wife; a kind of deer or antelope; N. of a mountain. भार्वर भार्वर, अस्, m., Ved. (according to Sāy., Ṛg-veda IV. 21, 7), a N. of Indra as son of Bharvara, = Jagad-bhartṛ, Prajā-pati, (perhaps to be referred to the horses of Indra as ‘bearing,’ ‘carry-ing,’ fr. rt. भृ।)
भार्श्य: भार्श्य भार्श्य, अम्, n. (fr. भृश), vehe-mence, violence; excessiveness.
भाल: भाल भाल, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 1. भा; according to some also भालस्, m.), the fore-head, brow; light, lustre. —भाल-कृत्, त्, m., N. of a man. —भाल-चन्द्र, अस्, m. ‘having the moon on his forehead,’ an epithet of Gaṇeśa. —भा-लचन्द्राचार्य (°र-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of a preceptor. —भाल-दर्शन, अम्, n. red lead (‘appearing on the forehead,’ being used to stain the forehead with lines &c.). —भाल-दर्शिन्, ई, इनी, इ, watching the brow or countenance (said of a servant who is attentive to a master's wishes). —भाल-दृश्, क्, or भाल-लोचन, अस्, m. ‘having an eye in the fore-head,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भालाङ्क (°ल-अङ्°), अस्, आ, अम्, having (auspicious) marks on the fore-head; (अस्), m. a man born with lucky lines on his forehead; a sort of fish (known as the Rohi, Cypri-nus Rohita); a tortoise; an epithet of Śiva; a saw; a species of leguminous plant or pot-herb.
भालु: भालु, उस्, m. the sun; [cf. भानु।]
भालन्दन: भालन्दन भालन्दन, अस्, m., Ved. a patro-nymic from Bhalandana, N. of Vatsa-prī; (also read बालन्दन।)
भालन्दनक: भालन्दनक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhalandana.
भालुक: भालुक भालुक, अस्, m. a bear; [cf. भल्ल।]
भालुकि: भालुकि भालुकि, इस्, m. (probably a patro-nymic), N. of a Muni.
भालुकिन्: भालुकिन्, ई, m., N. of a preceptor (= वालुकिन्).
भालुकीपुत्र: भालुकी-पुत्र, अस्, m. (fr. भालुकी, f.), Ved. ‘the son of Bhālukī,’ N. of a preceptor.
भाल्ल: भाल्ल भाल्ल, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or com-ing from Bhalla, q. v.
भाल्लवि: भाल्लवि भाल्लवि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Bhallavi.
भाल्लविन्: भाल्लविन्, इनस्, m. pl. the pupils of Bhallavin (?). —भाल्लवि-ब्राह्मण, अम्, n. and भाल्लवि-शाखा, f. and भाल्लवि-श्रुति, इस्, f. and भाल्लव्य्-उपनिषद्, त्, f., N. of certain Vedic works.
भाल्लवेय: भाल्लवेय, अस्, m., Ved. a patronymic from Bhāllavi, of Indra-dyumna; N. of a preceptor. —भाल्लवेय-श्रुति, इस्, f., N. of a Vedic work. —भाल्लवेयोपनिषद् (°य-उप्°), त्, f., N. of an Upaniṣad.
भाल्लुक: भाल्लुक भाल्लुक or भाल्लूक, अस्, m. a bear; [cf. भल्ल, भल्लुक, भल्लूक, भालुक।]
भाल्लेय: भाल्लेय भाल्लेय, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to or coming from Bhalla, q. v.
भाव: भाव भाव, अस्, m. (fr. rt. 1. भू), becom-ing, being, existing, existence, taking place, occurring, appearing, appearance; state of being, condition of existence, state, condition, relationship; manner, mode; true condition or state, truth, (भावेन, in truth, really, truly); manner of being, nature, natural state, innate property, temperament, disposition, temper, (एको भावः, a simple or artless nature); any state of mind or body, affection, sentiment, feel-ing, emotion, passion, (in the dramatic system of the Hindūs, two kinds of Bhāvas are usually enumerated, see स्थायिन्, व्यभि-चारिन्; but other divisions are also given, see अनु-भाव, वि-भाव, सात्त्विक-भाव); feeling of love, inclination, attachment, (भावं तेषु चक्रे, he felt an affection for them; सा तस्मिन् भावम् बबन्ध, she fixed her affec-tions on him); inclination or disposition of mind, (यादृशेन भावेन, with whatever disposition or condition of mind); sentiment, idea, thought, opinion, supposition, conjecture; resolution, intention, pur-pose, (दृढो भावः, a firm resolution); purport, tenor, scope, drift; meaning, sense, (इति भावः, ‘such is the sense,’ constantly used by Indian com-mentators at the end of their interpretations); con-templation, reflection, abstract meditation; the seat of the feelings and affections, the heart, soul, mind, (परितुष्टेन भावेन, with a pleased mind, Manu IV. 227; यदा मन्येत भावेन, when he believes in his mind, Manu VII. 171; but according to Kullūka, भावेन here = तत्त्व-तस्, truly); that which is or exists, a being, living creature, thing, matter, object, substance, (सर्व-भावेषु निःस्पृ-हः, one who is free from attachment to all [earthly] objects); behaviour, conduct, act, action, movement, gesture; amorous gesture, corporeal expression of amorous sentiments, wanton sport, dalliance (= लीला); passing from one state to another, change or substi-tution of one nature for another, (दन्त्यानाम् मूर्-धन्य-भावः, the change of dentals to cerebrals; भो-भावः, the existence or substitution [for the name of a person] of the expression भोस्, Manu II. 124); birth; the place of birth, the womb (= योनि); the place of being, the world, universe; an organ of sense; superhuman power; the Supreme Being; advice, instruction: (in theatrical language) a learned or worthy man, a man of dignity or conse-quence, gentleman, master, honourable sir [cf. भाव-मिश्र, 2. भवत्]: (in astronomy) the state or condition of a planet; an astrological house, mansion, lunar mansion; N. of the twenty-seventh Kalpa; of the eighth (forty-second) year in Jupiter's cycle of sixty years; (in Pāṇini's grammatical system) a term for an impersonal passive or neuter verb having neither agent nor object expressed (e. g. पच्यते, there is cooking, i. e. cooking is going on); the abstract idea conveyed by a word, the sense of the abstract noun (as describing the state or condition of anything; sometimes used at the end of a comp. instead of the affixes ता, त्व, य, e. g. बाल-भाव = बाल-ता, &c., the state of a child, childhood; and even added pleonastically to the abstract noun itself, e. g. तनुता-भाव, the state of thinness); the sense of a noun of action (as expressing the idea of the root, e. g. going, doing, &c.): = मिश्र-भाव, N. of the author of the Bhāva-prakāśa. —भाव-कल्प-लता, f., N. of a commentary by Bhaṭṭa-mudgala on the Bhāvanā-viveka, q. v. —भाव-गम्भीरम्, ind. from the bottom of the heart, (भाव-गम्भीरं जहसुः, they laughed heartily); deeply; gravely. —भाव-गम्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be ascertained by reflection or by meditating in the heart. —भाव-ग्राहिन्, ई, इणी, इ, apprehending the sense, appre-ciating the sentiment. —भाव-चूडा-मणि, इस्, m., N. of a work. —भाव-ज, अस्, m. ‘produced in the heart,’ love; the god of love; [cf. मनो-ज।] —भाव-ज्ञ, अस्, आ, अम्, knowing the heart. —भाव-तस्, ind. through being, in consequence of being, (ज्ञाति-भावतस्, through being a relation.) —भाव-त्व, अम्, n. the state of Bhāva, q. v. —भाव-दीप, अस्, m., N. of a commentary on the Tattva-prakāśa; = भारत-भावदीप. —भा-व-दीपिका, f., N. of a commentary. —भाव-नारा-यण-माहात्म्य, अम्, n., N. of a work. —भाव-पदार्थ, अस्, m. a thing which has a real or posi-tive existence. —भाव-पाद, अस्, m., N. of a lexi-cographer. —भाव-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a medical work by Bhava-deva-miśra. —भाव-प्रकाशिका, f., N. of a grammatical commentary. —भाव-प्र-त्यय-वादार्थ (°द-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a work by Mathurā-nātha Tarka-vāg-īśa Bhaṭṭācārya. —भा-व-प्रदीपिका, f., N. of a commentary on the Mālatī-mādhava. —भाव-बन्धन, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘heart-enchaining,’ fettering the heart, joining hearts (as love). —भाव-बोधक, अस्, इका, अम्, revealing or displaying any sentiment, indicating a feeling or passion. —भाव-मिश्र, अस्, m. (in dramatic lan-guage) a gentleman, a man of dignity or consequence, master, sir; N. of the author of the Bhāva-prakāśa, (also called Miśra-bhāva and Bhāva-deva-miśra.) —भाव-राम-कृष्ण, अस्, m., N. of a man men-tioned in the second part of the Prabodha-candrodaya. —भाव-रूप, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘consisting of reality,’ actually being, really existing, real, actual; (अम्), n. (?), N. of a work. —भाव-वचन, अस्, आ, अम्, (in gram.) signifying a state or action, denoting the abstract notion of a verb. —भाव-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, being in a state or condition. —भाव-वाचक (?), an abstract noun. —भाव-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a Buddhist teacher. —भाव-वृत्त, अस्, आ, अम्, relat-ing to creation, concerned with cosmogony; (अस्), m., N. of Brahmā. —भाववृत्तीय, अस्, आ, अम्, an adj. formed from भाव-वृत्त. —भाव-शतक, अम्, n., N. of a work. —भाव-शबल-ता, f. or भाव-शबला, f. mixture or union of various emo-tions. —भाव-शान्ति, इस्, f. the allaying of any (transitory) emotion. —भाव-शुद्धि, इस्, f. purity of mind. —भाव-शून्य, अस्, आ, अम्, void of affec-tion or attachment. —भाव-संशुद्धि, इस्, f. purification of the natural condition, purity of nature. —भाव-सन्धि, इस्, m. union of emotions or feel-ings, co-existence of two emotions, a vacillating frame of mind between conflicting emotions and feelings. —भाव-समाहित, अस्, आ, अम्, fixed or collected in mind, abstracted, devout. —भाव-सर्ग, अस्, m. the intellectual creation (comprising the faculties of the human mind and their affections, as distinguished from the material creation, see भौतिक). —भाव-सार-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a work by Gaṅgā-dhara Mahāḍakara. —भाव-स्थ, अस्, आ, अम्, being in a state of love or affection, attached, enamoured. —भाव-स्निग्ध, अस्, आ, अम्, attached in heart or mind, affectionately disposed. —भावाकूत (°व-आक्°), अम्, n. the thoughts of the heart or mind. —भावा-गणेश-दीक्षित, अस्, m., N. of the author of several commentaries. —भावात्मक (°व-आत्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘consisting of reality,’ real, actual; [cf. भाव-रूप।] —भावात्मक-ता, f. reality. —भा-वाद्वैत (°व-अद्°), अम्, n. natural cause; material cause (as thread of cloth). —भावानन्दी (°व-आन्°), f., N. of a commentary by Bhāvānanda Siddhānta-vāg-īśa on the Dīdhiti or Śiro-maṇi. —भावाननदी-प्रकाश, अस्, m., N. of a commentary on the pre-ceding by Mahā-deva Pandit. —भावानुग (°व-अन्°), अस्, आ, अम्, ‘following the object,’ natural, simple, not forced or assumed; (आ), f. a shadow; [cf. भावालीना।] —भावान्तर (°व-अन्°), अम्, n. another state, a different state or condition. —भा-वाभास (°व-आभ्°), अस्, m. simulation of feeling or emotion. —भावार्थ (°व-अर्°), अस्, m. the simple or inherent meaning (of words), the obvious purport (of a phrase &c.), subject-matter. —भावार्थ-दी-पिका, f. ‘light of the inherent meaning,’ N. of a metrical commentary by Gaurī-kānta Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya on the Tarka-bhāṣā; on the Vṛtta-ratnā-kara by Janārdana-vibudha; = भागवत-भ्°, q. v. —भावालीना (°व-आल्°), f. ‘cleaving to an object,’ a shadow; [cf. भावानुगा।] —भावोदय (°व-उद्°), अस्, m. the rising of emotion or passion.
भाव, भावनीय, भावयत्, भावित, भाव्य, &c. See pp. 707, 708.
भावक: भावक, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to be, effecting; promoting any one's welfare; imagin-ing, fancying; having a taste for the beautiful; having a poetical taste; (अस्), m. sentiment, feeling, affec-tion, emotion; the external expression of amatory sentiments; [cf. भावाट, col. 2.]
भावन: 2. भावन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. the Caus.; for 1. भा-वन see p. 704, col. 1), causing to be, causing, forming, creating, framing, manifesting; promoting or effecting any one's welfare; imagining, fancying; teaching; (अस्), m. a creator, producer, efficient cause; N. of Śiva (= ध्यातृ); N. of the twenty-second Kalpa; (आ, अम्), f. n. the act of causing to be or creating, manifesting, manifestation; promotion of any one's interests (= वर्धन); the act of form-ing in the mind, conceiving, imagination, conception, fancy, thought, (भावनया, in thought, in imagina-tion); reflection, meditation, abstract meditation, con-templation; supposition, hypothesis, mental perception, recollection; observing, investigating; settling, fixing, determining; (in law) proof, demonstration, argu-ment, ascertainment; (in medicine) saturating any dry powder with fluid, steeping, infusion, drying an article by day and keeping it moist at night; (in arithmetic) finding by combination or composition [cf. समास-भ्°]; decorating with flowers and perfumes, scenting, anointing; (at the end of an adj. comp.) = nature, essence; (आ), f., N. of an Upaniṣad; a crow (= का-रव); water, = अम्बु; (अम्), n. apprehen-sion, perception; the fruit of the Dillenia Speciosa (= भव्य, भविष्य); N. of a wood, (perhaps for 1. भा-वन, q. v.) —भावना-मय, अस्, ई, अम्, produced by imagination or fancy, imaginary. —भावना-युक्त, अस्, आ, अम्, thoughtful, full of anxiety, anxious. —भावना-विवेक, अस्, m., N. of a commentary on a metrical treatise on the nature of injunction according to the theory of Madhu. —भावनाश्रय (°न-आश्°), अस्, m. ‘the refuge of thought,’ an epithet of Śiva. —भावना-सार-सङ्-ग्रह, अस्, m., N. of a Vedānta work by Mudgala Bhaṭṭa.
भावनिका: भावनिका, f., N. of a woman.
भावनीय: भावनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, (fr. the Caus.) to be manifested, to be effected or accomplished; to be conceived or imagined, to be fancied; to be medi-tated on; to be proved, requiring demonstration; to be taught.
भावयत्: भावयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, fancying, imagining, calling to mind; reflecting on, meditating on.
भावयव्य: भावयव्य, अस्, m. (fr. भावयु), Ved., N. of the author of the hymn Ṛg-veda I. 126, 6; a patronymic of Svana-ja.
भावयितव्य: भावयितव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), Ved. to be cherished, to be protected or taken care of.
भावयितृ: भावयितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, Ved. causing to be; pro-moting the welfare (of any one), cherishing, taking care of, protecting; a cherisher, protector.
भावयु: भावयु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. cherishing, taking care of, protecting.
भावाट: भावाट, अस्, m. = भावक, affection, emotion, passion; the external expression or indication of amatory feeling; a pious or holy man; an amorous man; an actor; dress, decoration.
भाविक: भाविक, अस्, ई, अम्, actually being or existing, real, natural, innate; full of feeling or sentiment, expressive, sentimental; future; (अम्), n. a descrip-tion of an imaginary object so vivid that it actually appears to be present, describing the past or future as present; = भावुक, language full of feeling or passion; (अस्), m. an equation involving products of unknown quantities.
भावित: भावित, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), caused to be, brought into being, produced, obtained, got; made to thrive, protected, cherished, fostered; made to become, transformed into; made to exist or appear, manifested, exhibited; made to exist in the mind, presented to the imagination, conceived, imagined, supposed, thought of; thought about, meditated on; fixed on (as the mind or thoughts); purified by meditation; known, recognised, acknowledged; proved, established; convicted; occupied with, per-vaded by, filled with; inspired by, animated; mixed with (as an ingredient); soaked in, saturated with, steeped, infused; perfumed with, scented; (in arith-metic and algebra) involving a product of unknown quantities; (अम्), n. a product obtained by multipli-cation, a factum. —भावित-बुद्धी, इस्, इस्, इ, one who has purified his mind by meditation &c.; see भा-वितात्मन्. —भावित-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one who has imagined or conceived or infused &c. —भावितात्मन् (°त-आत्°), आ, आ, अ, one whose soul is purified or who has purified it by meditating on the universal soul, one who has perceived or whose thoughts are fixed on the Supreme Spirit; thoughtful, meditative; intent upon, engaged in; a sage; (आ), m., N. of the thirteenth Muhūrta.
भावितक: भावितक, the product of a multiplication; [cf. भावित above.]
भावित्र: भावित्र, अम्, n. the three worlds (viz. earth, heaven, and the lower regions or the atmosphere), the universe; [cf. भवित्र।]
भाविन्: भाविन्, इ, इनि, इ, becoming, being, existing [cf. भृत्य-भ्°, पूर्व-भ्°]; about to be, about to come to pass, future; predestined; what ought to be; what will fall to the share of (any one); attached to, (हरि-भाविन्, attached to Hari); being pos-sessed of, (at the end of a comp., e. g. ज्ञान-विज्ञा-न-भ्°, possessing sacred and profane knowledge); beautiful, illustrious; (ई), m. (according to the Vāja-saneyi-prātiśākhya) every vowel except अ and आ (perhaps so called as liable to become changed into the corresponding semivowels); N. of the caste of Śūdras in Plaksha-dvīpa; (इनी), f. a distinguished or handsome woman; a lady, noble lady [cf. भ-व्य]; a wanton woman; N. of one of the Mātṛs attending on Skanda; of a daughter of a Gandharva; [cf. अ-निरुद्ध-भ्°।] —भावि-ता, f. the state of being or becoming, (तद्-भाव-भावि-ता, conform-ing one's self to the mode of thought of that person); futurity, predestination. —भावि-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being or becoming, the being obliged to take place, inevitableness, unavoidableness, necessity. —भाव्य्-उपध, अस्, m., scil. विसर्जनीय, a Visarjanīya following in the Pada-pāṭha after any vowel except the vowel अ or आ।
भावुक: भावुक, अस्, आ, अम्, being, disposed to be, about to be, becoming, (sometimes used like भविष्णु at the end of a comp. after an adv. in अम्, cf. आढ्-यम्-भ्°, अन्धम्-भ्°, दूरम्-भ्°, नग्नम्-भ्°, पलितम्-भ्°, प्रियम्-भ्°); happy, well, auspicious, prosperous; having a taste for the beautiful, having a poetical taste; (अस्), m. (in theatrical language) a sister's husband; (अम्), n. language full of feeling or passion; happiness, auspiciousness, welfare.
भाव्य: भाव्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. भू or its Caus.), being, existing at the present time (Ved., cf. भव्य); about to be or happen, future, to be become, what must or ought to be or become, (sometimes used for the future tense of the verb, e. g. पुलहो भाव्यो महर्षिः, Pulaha is to be reckoned a great Ṛṣi; and often impersonally, e. g. भाव्यं तया, it is to be become by her, i. e. she must become); to be effected or accomplished, to be performed; to be appre-hended or perceived; to be imagined or conceived [cf. दुर्-भ्°]; to be convinced; to be argued or proved or demonstrated; to be investigated or de-termined; (according to Vedic commentators) = भावयव्य, to be honoured or worshipped?; (अस्), m., N. of a king (= भाव्य-रथ or भानु-रथ). —भाव्य-ता, f. or भाव्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state of being about to happen, futurity. —भा-व्य-रथ, अस्, m., N. of a king; [cf. भाव्य।]
भावड: भावड भावड, अस्, m., N. of a man.
भावत: भावत भावत, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. 2. भवत्), your honour's, your, thy (respectfully).
भावत्क: भावत्क, अस्, ई, अम्, your honour's, your, thy, thine.
भावला: भावला भावला, f., N. of the wife of Bhā-vaḍa.
भावाव: भावाव भावाव, अस्, आ, अम् (said to be fr. भाव + अव fr. rt. अव्), delicate, tender, compas-sionate.
भाष्: भाष् 1. भाष् (connected with rt. 1. भा as Gr. φη-μί with φαίνω), cl. 1. A. भाषते (ep. also P. -ति), बभाषे, भाषितुम्, to speak, talk, say; to speak to, address (with acc. of the person or sometimes with acc. of the person and thing); to tell or announce (anything) to (any one); to speak of or about; to reply, to call or name; to use or employ in speaking; to describe: Pass. भाष्यते, to be spoken, to be addressed or spoken to (sometimes with acc., e. g. स वचो मु-निना बभाषे, he was addressed by the Muni in a speech): Caus. भाषयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबभा-षत् or अबीभषत्, to cause to speak or talk; to say or speak; to cause disquietude, disturb (?): Desid. बिभाषिषते: Intens. बाभाष्यते, बाभाष्टि।
भाष् 2. भाष् (fr. rt. भष्), Ved. occur-ring only in the comp. रक्षो-भाष्, barking like a Rākṣasa.
भाषक: भाषक, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, talking about, (at the end of a comp.)
भाषण: भाषण, अम्, n. speaking, talking, saying; speech, talk; kind words, kindness, = साम-दानादि; (in theatrical language) expression of satisfaction at the end of a drama, applause (?).
भाषत्: भाषत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, speaking, saying, talking.
भाषमाण: भाषमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, speaking, saying, talking.
भाषा: भाषा, f. speech, language [cf. देश-भ्°, पर-भ्°, भूत-भ्°]; common or vernacular speech (in ancient times as opposed to Vedic, in later as opposed to Sanskrit), any Prākṛt dialect, (the five Prākṛts or vernaculars, viz. Mahā-rāṣṭrī, Śaurasenī, Māgadhī, Prācyā, and Avantī, are called Pañca-vidhā Bhāṣā); description, definition; (in law) an accusation, charge, complaint, plaint; N. of Sarasvatī (goddess of speech); of a Rāgiṇī. —भाषा-ज्ञ, अस्, m., N. of a man. —भाषान्तर (°षा-अन्°), अम्, n. another dialect or version, a translation. —भाषा-परिच्छेद, अस्, m. ‘definition of (the categories of) speech,’ N. of a compendium of the Vaiśeṣika branch of the Nyāya system of philosophy by Viśva-nātha. —भाषा-पाद, अम्, n. the plaint or charge, the first of the four stages of a lawsuit. —भाषा-मञ्जरी, f., N. of an elementary work on Sanskrit grammar. —भा-षार्णव (°षा-अर्°), अस्, m., N. of a work by Candra-śekhara. —भाषा-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a commentary on Pāṇini's grammar. —भाषावृत्त्य्-अर्थ-वृत्ति, इस्, f., N. of a commentary on the preceding work. —भाषा-सम, अस्, m. a particular figure in rhetoric, a sentence so arranged that it may be either Sanskrit or Prākṛt. —भाषा-समिति, इस्, f. (with Jainas) one of the Samitis, moderation in speech.
भाषिक: भाषिक, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to common or vernacular speech.
भाषित: भाषित, अस्, आ, अम्, spoken, uttered, said; (अम्), n. that which is spoken, speech, language, talk, speaking. —भाषित-पुंस्क, अस्, अम्, m. n. = उक्त-पुंस्क, q. v.
भाषितव्य: भाषितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be spoken to or addressed.
भाषितृ: भाषितृ, ता, त्री, तृ, a speaker, talker; speak-ing, talking, telling.
भाषिन्: भाषिन्, ई, इणी, इ, speaking, talking, saying, tell-ing, a speaker, (commonly at the end of a comp., cf. अल्प-भ्°, प्राकृत-भ्°); loquacious, a chatterer.
भाष्य: भाष्य, अम्, n. speaking, talking; any work in the common or vernacular speech; an explanatory work, exposition, explanation, commentary in general (but especially the explanation of technical Sūtras or aphorisms); Patañjali's commentary on the Sūtras of Pāṇini [cf. महा-भाष्य]; a sort of house or building. —भाष्य-कर or भाष्य-कार, अस्, or भाष्य-कृत्, त्, m. ‘commentary-maker,’ the writer of any explanatory work or commentary, a commentator, scholiast, an expounder of technical Sūtras or aphorisms; (especially) an epithet of Patañ-jali, the author of the Mahā-bhāṣya or great com-mentary on Pāṇini; epithet of the commentators Nātha and Śaṅkarācārya. —भाष्य-टीका, f., N. of a commentary on the Mahā-bhāṣya; of another commentary better known as Śrīmad-bhāṣya-ṭīkā. —भाष्य-प्रदीप, अस्, m., N. of Kaiyaṭa's com-mentary on the Mahā-bhāṣya. —भाष्यप्रदीप-विवरण, अम्, n., N. of Iśvarānanda's explanation of the Bhāṣya-pradīpa. —भाष्यप्रदीपोद्द्योत (°प-उद्°), अस्, m., N. of Nāgojī-bhaṭṭa's expla-nation of Kaiyaṭa's Bhāṣya-pradīpa. —भाष्य-रत्न-प्रभा, f., N. of a commentary on the Śārīraka-mīmāṃsā-bhāṣya.
भाष्यमाण: भाष्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being spoken to or addressed.
भाषणीक्षौलेम: भाषणीक्षौलेम भाषणीक्षौलेम, आस्, m. pl., N. of a race (?).
भास्: भास् 1. भास् (connected with rt. 1. भा), cl. 1. A. (in epic poetry also P.) भासते (-ति), बभासे, भासिष्यते, अभासिष्ट, भासितुम्, to shine, to be bright; to appear; to appear or come into the mind, to be conceived or imagined, to become clear or evident: Caus. भास-यति, -यितुम्, Aor. अबभासत् and अबीभसत्, to make shine, illuminate; to cause to appear, show, make evident: Desid. बिभासिषते: Intens. बाभा-स्यते, बाभास्ति; [cf. Hib. beosach, ‘bright, glitter-ing,’ perhaps mais, ‘sparkling;’ probably Lat. fes-tra, fas-tus.]

2. भास्, f. n. (according to some fr. rt. 1. भा, q. v.; but according to Pāṇini III. 2, 177, fr. rt. 1. भास्), light, glare, lustre, brightness; a ray or gleam of light, (भासां निधिः, receptacle of rays of light, the sun); an image, reflection, shadow; glory, splendor, power, majesty; wish, desire. —भासा-केतु, उस्, उस्, उ (fr. भासा inst. c. + केतु), Ved. perceivable by light, appearing through light; (Sāy. = ज्वाला-लक्षण-ज्ञापक।) —भास्-कर, अस्, ई, अम्, ‘light-causing,’ shining, glittering, bright, re-splendent; (अस्), m. the sun, (if used at the end of an adj. comp. the fem. will end in आ); N. of Śiva; fire; a hero; the plant Calotropis Gigantea (= अर्क); N. of various men; of a famous Hindū astronomer, (also called Bhāskarācārya, q. v.; भास्-कर is often found at the end of names, cf. ज्ञान-भ्°, ब्रह्मण्य-भ्°, भगवद्-भ्°, भगवन्त-भ्°, भाट्ट-भ्°); (अम्), n. gold; N. of a Tīrtha. —भास्कर-नृसिंह, अस्, m., N. of a Scholiast of the last century. —भास्कर-प्रिय, अस्, m. ‘fond of the sun,’ a ruby. —भास्कर-भट्ट, अस्, m., N. of an author. —भास्कर-मिश्र, अस्, m., N. of an author; (also called भट्ट-भ्°।) —भास्-कर-लवण, अम्, n. a particular mixture (contain-ing salt &c.). —भास्कर-वर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a king of Kāma-rūpa; of a person mentioned in the Daśa-kumāra-carita, p. 194, 1. 14. —भास्कर-व्रत, अम्, n., N. of a particular religious observ-ance. —भास्कर-शर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a com-mentator of the seventeenth century; [cf. हरि-भास्कर।] —भास्कर-सप्तमी, f., N. of the seventh day in the light half of the month Māgha. —भास्कराचार्य (°र-आच्°), अस्, m., N. of an author; N. of a celebrated astronomer and mathe-matician who lived in the twelfth century and wrote the Siddhānta-śiro-maṇi (which contains treatises on algebra, arithmetic, and geometry, called Vīja-gaṇita and Līlāvatī). —भास्करि, इस्, m. (a patronymic fr. भास्-कर), the planet Saturn; N. of a Muni. —भास्करीय, अस्, आ, अम्, belonging to or coming from Bhāskara; (अस्), m. a pupil of Bhāskara. —भास्करेष्टा (°र-इष्°), f. the plant Polanisia Icosandra. —भास्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing light, luminous, splendid, shining; (आन्), m. the sun; light, lustre, brightness; a hero; (अती), f. the city of the sun; N. of a work; (according to Naighaṇṭuka 1. 8) = उषस्, dawn; (यस्), f. pl. (according to Naighaṇ-ṭuka 1. 13) = नदी, a river. —भास्वती-करण, अम्, n., N. of a work.
भास: भास, अस्, m. (sometimes written भाष), light, lustre, brightness; shining, (at the end of a comp., e. g. चन्द्र-भास, shining as the moon); im-pression made on the mind, fancy; a vulture; a cock; a sort of bird described as a water-fowl; = शकुन्त; = कुक्कुट; = नील-पक्षः पक्षी; a cow-shed, cattle-fold (= गोष्ठ); N. of a Sāman (also अम्, n.); of a man; of a dramatic poet; of a son of a minister of king Candra-prabha; of a Dā-nava; of a mountain; (ई), f. the mother of the Bhāsas or vultures; N. of a daughter of Prādhā. —भास-कर्ण, अस्, m., N. of a Rākṣasa. —भास-ता, f. the being a vulture or bird of prey; vulturous nature, rapacity. —भास-विलास-संवाद, अस्, m., N. of the twenty-fifth chapter of the Vāsisṭha-rāmāyaṇa, commonly called Yoga-vāsiṣṭha. —भासा-पुर, अम्, n., N. of a town.
भासक: भासक, अस्, इका, अम् (fr. the Caus.), causing to appear, making evident, showing, manifesting; en-lightening; making intelligible, (usually at the end of comps.); (अस्), m., N. of a dramatic poet. —भा-सक-त्व, अम्, n. enlightenment, &c.
भासन: भासन, अम्, n. shining, glittering, illuminating.
भासन्त: भासन्त, अस्, ई, अम्, shining, splendid; beautiful, handsome; (अस्), m. the sun; the moon; a star, an asterism; the bird Bhāsa, q. v.; (ई), f. an asterism, a Nakṣatra.
भासमान: भासमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, radiant; ap-pearing.
भासयत्: भासयत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, making to shine, illu-minating; shining, radiant (?).
भासस्: भासस्, अस्, n., Ved. brightness, light, lustre.
भासाय: भासाय, Nom. A. भासायते, &c., to act the part of the bird Bhāsa, to appear like this bird.
भासिन्: भासिन्, ई, इनी, इ, (at the end of a comp.) shining, brilliant (e. g. ऊर्ध्व-भ्°, shining upwards; cf. ज्योतिर्-भ्°).
भासुर: भासुर, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, splendid; terrible, (in this sense probably an incorrect form); (अस्), m. a crystal; a hero; (अम्), n. Costus Speciosus or Arabicus; [cf. भास्वर।] —भासुर-त्व, अम्, n. splendor. —भासुर-पुषपा, f. the plant Tragia Involucrata (= वृश्चि-काली).
भासुरक: भासुरक, अस्, m., N. of a lion (in Pañca-tantra, p. 53, 1. 17).
भास्य: भास्य, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. the Caus.), to be made visible, to be brought to light. —भास्य-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition of appearing, visibleness. —भास्य-सूत्र, अम्, n., N. of a section in the Kāktantra treating of the meaning of grammatical forms.
भास्वर: भास्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, radiant, brilliant, bright, resplendent; (अस्), m. the sun; a day; N. of a satellite of the god of the sun; of a Buddhist deity; (अम्), n. Costus Arabicus or Speciosus (= कुष्ठ; cf. प्र-भ्°, भासुर).
भासद: भासद भासद, अस्, m., औ, m. du. (fr. भसद्), Ved. (perhaps) the buttocks.
भास्कर: भास्कर भास्-कर। See under 2. भास्, col. 2.
भास्त्रायण: भास्त्रायण भास्त्रायण, भास्त्रायणक (fr. भस्त्रा), see Gaṇa Arīhaṇādi to Pāṇ. IV. 2, 80.
भास्मन: भास्मन भास्मन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भस्मन्), made or consisting of ashes, ashy.
भास्मायन्य: भास्मायन्य, अस्, m. a patronymic from Bhas-man; भास्मायनास्, m. pl., see Gaṇa Kuñjādi to Pāṇ. IV. 1, 98.
भिःखराज: भिःखराज भिःख-राज, अस्, m., N. of a king.
भिक्ष्: भिक्ष् भिक्ष् (probably for बिहक्ष्, Desid. of rt. भज्), cl. 1. A. (ep. also P.) भिक्षते, बिभिक्षे, भिक्षिष्यते, अभिक्षिष्ट, भिक्षितुम्, lit. to wish to share or partake; to beg for, ask for; to desire, implore (Ved. with acc. and gen., e. g. भिक्षे सुमतिं तुराणाम्, I implore your favour against eager foes, Ṛg-veda 1. 171, 1); to solicit, to beg alms (with abl. of person or with a double acc.); to obtain; to ask for without obtain-ing; to be weary or distressed (?); to speak (?): Caus. भिक्षयति, -यितुम्, to cause to beg, &c.
भिक्षण: भिक्षण, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of begging, asking alms.
भिक्षमाण: भिक्षमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, asking, begging.
भिक्षा: भिक्षा, f. the act of begging, asking [cf. मांस-भ्°]; anything given as alms or obtained by begging, (sometimes in comp. with the object asked for, e. g. पुत्र-भिक्षां देहि, grant the boon of a son, lit. a son as alms); alms, food given as alms [cf. दुर्-भिक्ष, सु-भ्°]; hire, wages (= भृति); service. —भिक्षा-करण, अम्, n. the act of ask-ing alms, begging. —भिक्षा-चर, अस्, ई, अम्, going about begging; a beggar, mendicant; (अस्), m., N. of a son of Bhoja, (also called भिक्षु।) —भिक्षा-चरण, अम्, n. or भिक्षा-चर्य, अम्, आ, n. f. the act of going about begging, begging, mendi-cancy. —भिक्षा-चार, अस्, ई, अम्, = भिक्षा-चर। —भिक्षाटन (°षा-अट्°), अस्, आ, अम्, wandering about begging or asking for alms, begging, men-dicity, mendicancy; (अस्), m. a mendicant; N. of a poet; (अम्), n. the act of begging, mendicancy, going about asking for alms; N. of a work; भिक्-षाटनं कृ, to wander about as a mendicant. —भिक्षान्न (°षा-अन्°), अम्, n. food obtained as alms; [cf. भिक्षाहार।] —भिक्षा-पात्र, अम्, n. a mendicant's bowl, vessel for collecting alms, alms-dish. —भिक्षा-प्रचार, अस्, m. = भिक्षा-चरण, q. v. —भिक्षा-भाण्ड, अम्, n. a mendi-cant's bowl or vessel. —भिक्षा-भुज्, क्, क्, क्, living on alms. —भिक्षा-माणव, अस्, m. a beggar boy, young beggar (as a term of contempt). —भिक्षा-यण (°षा-अय्°), अम्, n. the act of plying for alms. —भिक्षार्थिन् (°षा-अर्°), ई, इनी, इ, asking for alms, a petitioner for charity; begging; a beggar or mendicant. —भिक्षार्ह (°षा-अर्°), अस्, आ, अम्, worthy of alms. —भिक्षा-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having or receiving alms, begging. —भिक्षा-वासस्, अस्, n. the garment of a mendicant, a beggar's dress. —भिक्-षा-वृत्ति, इस्, इस्, इ, living or subsisting on alms, begging. —भिक्षाशि-त्व (°षा-आश्°), अम्, n. the eating begged food, subsisting on alms; mendi-cancy; profligacy, roguery. —भिक्षाशिन् (°षा-आश्°), इ, इनी, इ, eating begged food, living or sub-sisting on alms; dishonest; [cf. भैक्षाश्य।] —भिक्षाहार (°षा-आह्°), अस्, m. begged food; [cf. भिक्षान्न।] —भिक्षोत्कर (°षा-उत्°), अस्, m. scattering alms. —भिक्षोपजीविन् (°षा-उप्°), ई, इनी, इ, subsisting by alms, one who lives by begging.
भिक्षाक: भिक्षाक, अस्, ई, m. f. begging, a beggar, men-dicant.
भिक्षित: भिक्षित, अस्, आ, अम्, begged, solicited or ob-tained as alms; [cf. शूद्र-भ्°।]
भिक्षितव्य: भिक्षितव्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be begged or asked for.
भिक्षिन्: भिक्षिन्, ई, इणी, इ, begging, asking for alms.
भिक्षु: भिक्षु, उस्, m. a beggar, mendicant, religious mendicant (especially a Brāhman of the fourth or mendicant order, i. e. one in the fourth āśrama or last stage of his life when he abandons his house and family and subsists entirely on alms; cf. आश्रम, महा-भ्°); a Buddhist mendicant; a particular Buddha; N. of an Āṅgīrasa (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda X. 117); of a son of Bhoja (= भिक्षा-चर); N. of a particular species of plant, = श्रा-वणी, = कोकिलाक्ष; (उ), n., N. of an Upaniṣad. —भिक्षु-चर्या, f. ‘a beggar's course of life,’ begging. —भिक्षु-तत्त्व, अम्, n., N. of a work. —भिक्षु-सङ्घ, अस्, m. a society of Buddhist mendicants. —भिक्षु-सङ्घाती, f. beggar's clothes, old or ragged raiment. —भिक्षु-सूत्र, अम्, n. a collection of rules or precepts for mendicants. —भिक्-षुसूत्र-भाष्य-वार्त्तिक, अम्, n., N. of a com-mentary on the preceding.
भिक्षुक: भिक्षुक, अस्, m. a beggar, mendicant, a Brāh-man of the mendicant order [cf. भिक्षु]; (ई), f. a female mendicant. —भिक्षुकी-पारक (?), N. of a building mentioned in Rāja-taraṅgiṇī VI. 191.
भिक्षुणी: भिक्षुणी, f. a Buddhist female mendicant or nun, (probably a Pāli form.)
भिक्ष्य: भिक्ष्य (fr. भिक्षा), Nom. P. भिक्ष्यति, &c., to beg or ask for alms, (a doubtful form.)
भिण्ड: भिण्ड भिण्ड or भिण्डक or भिण्डीतक, अस्, m. or भिण्डा, f. the plant Abelmoschus Escu-lentus.
भित्त: भित्त, अम्, n. a fragment, broken piece, bit; a part, portion; = भित्ति, a partition, wall.
भिद्: भिद् 1. भिद्, cl. 7. P. A. भिनत्ति, भिन्त्ते (Ved. also cl. 1. भेदति), Impf. अभिनत् (2nd sing. अभिनस् or अभिनत्, 1st sing. Ved. अभेदम्, 2nd sing. अभेत्, भेत्), Impv. भि-नत्तु (2nd sing. भिन्द्धि or भिन्धि), बिभेद (2nd sing. बिभेदिथ), बिभिदे (Part. बिभिद्वस्), भेत्स्यति, -ते, Aor. अभिदत् and अभैत्सीत्, अभित्त (2nd sing. अभित्थास्), Inf. भेत्तुम् (Ved. भेत्-तवै), to break, split, cleave, slit, cut asunder, sever, rend, tear, pierce, penetrate; to break through or down, burst through (e. g. सेतुम् भिद्, to break through an embankment; तिमिरम् भिद्, to break through or disperse darkness); to violate (e. g. सन्-धिम् भिद्, to violate a compact or alliance); to interrupt, disturb; to tear up; to destroy; to divide, separate; to open; to make to open or blossom, expand; to divide into parts or portions, disjoin, disunite; to loose, loosen, dissolve; to unravel, extri-cate; to betray, disclose; to set at variance; to unsettle, perplex; to alter, change, make to differ; to distinguish, discriminate: Pass. भिद्यते, to be split; to burst (e. g. शीतेन, with frost); to be torn asunder; to be destroyed; to be harassed or afflicted; to be divided or separated; to open, be opened, become relaxed; to expand, blossom, bloom; to become loose, be loosened; to separate one's self from, keep aloof from (with inst.); to differ or be different from (with abl.); to alter, change; to be divulged: Caus. भेदयति, -यितुम्, अबीभिदत्, to cause to break or split &c., to break, split, cleave, divide, tear or dash to pieces; to destroy, overcome; to separate, dissolve, disunite, unsettle (in opinion), perplex, set at variance, cause dispersion; to seduce: Desid. of Caus. बिभेदयिषति: Desid. बिभित्-सति, -ते: Intens. बेभिद्यते, बेभिदीति, बेभेत्ति, to break or split repeatedly, to divide or cut into again and again; [cf. Lat. findo, fi-nis fr. fid-nis (?): Goth. bit, ‘to bite;’ beita, bait, bitum: Old Germ. biz.]

2. भिद्, त्, त्, त्, (at the end of a comp.) breaking, splitting, dividing, piercing; a breaker, &c.; break-ing to pieces, destroying [cf. अश्म-भ्°, गिरि-भ्°, गोत्र-भ्°, तमो-भ्°, पुर-भ्°]; (त्), f., Ved. a breaker, destroyer, &c.; breaking, splitting, dividing; difference; different sort, kind.
भित्ति: भित्ति, इस्, f. breaking, splitting, tearing, dividing; a wall of earth or masonry, a partition; a mat (made of split reeds); anything broken or divided; a rent, fissure; a fragment, bit, piece, portion, part; a place, spot; a flaw, defect, deficiency; an opportunity, occasion; an asylum (?). —भित्ति-खातन, अस्, m. ‘wall-digger,’ one who digs into or undermines walls, a rat; [cf. भित्ति-पातन।] —भित्ति-चौर, अस्, m. ‘wall-burglar,’ a house-breaker (the mud wall of the Hindū cottages being easily cut through by burglars). —भित्ति-पातन, अस्, m. ‘wall-overthrower, wall-destroyer,’ a kind of rat; [cf. भित्ति-खातन।]
भित्तिका: भित्तिका, f. a partition, wall; a small house-lizard; (अस्, आ, अम्) = भित्ति (at the end of an adj. comp.).
भित्त्वा: भित्त्वा, ind. having broken, having split, having burst through, &c.
भिदक: भिदक, अस्, m. ‘cutter or wounder,’ a sword; (अम्), n. Indra's thunderbolt.
भिदा: भिदा, f. breaking, splitting, piercing, bursting in pieces, tearing, rending [cf. दुर्-भिद]; dividing, separation; difference; sort, kind, species; coriander.
भिदापन: भिदापन, अम्, n. (fr. an irregular Caus. भि-दापय), the act of causing to break, causing to pound or trample on.
भिदि: भिदि, इस्, or भिदु, उस्, m. Indra's thunderbolt.
भिदिर: भिदिर, अम्, n. a thunderbolt (= भिदि above).
भिदुर: भिदुर, अस्, आ, अम्, breaking, splitting, piercing, destroying; easily broken or split, fragile, brittle; divided, variegated, mingled; (अम्), n. a thunderbolt [cf. भिदिर]. —भिदुर-स्वन, अस्, m. ‘making a piercing sound, N. of an Asura; (in Hari-vaṃśa’ 2289 also read मृदुर-स्वन, सृमरः खनः।)
भिदेलिम: भिदेलिम, अस्, आ, अम्, to be broken or split, easily broken, brittle, fragile.
भिद्य: भिद्य, अस्, m. a rushing river (‘one bursting its banks’); N. of a river; [cf. पूर्-भ्°।]
भिद्यमान: भिद्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being broken or split or pierced; being divided or separated; being dis-tinguished.
भिद्वत्: भिद्-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. containing the root भिद्।
भिन्दत्: भिन्दत्, अन्, अती, अत्, breaking, splitting, cleaving, piercing, destroying, dividing.
